# Pancake

> Pancake is the AI coworker that does the work for you. One coworker in your Slack, a whole team of agents behind it — growth, engineering, operations — running 24/7 and reporting back in Slack. $49/month flat, tokens at the labs' public price, no tiers. Built on the OpenClaw runtime. Takes founding teams from $1 to $1M without hiring.

## What Pancake does

Pancake gives you an AI coworker that knows your company better than you and handles 50–70% of recurring work by default. Behind it, squads of agents with their own memory, tools, and schedules work continuously. Agents pull context from your Notion, docs, and meeting notes — they know your business. Every tool call, message, and decision is written to an immutable log. You always have the last word.

## Who it's for

Solo founders scaling past $50K ARR without wanting to hire. Multiplayer founding teams who want 10x the output with the same headcount. Operators who want AI that works proactively — not just when prompted.

## The problem it solves

Most AI tools are reactive. They wait to be prompted. When you close the tab, they stop. Pancake is the infrastructure — the harness — that lets AI work autonomously: running outbound, shipping content, filing invoices, monitoring production, while you sleep.
